# Sourcey

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://sourcey.com/docs/introduction.md): Sourcey tells the whole product story. Specs, code, rich guides, changelog, roadmap pages, examples, and portable context files from your project as static HTML.
- [Install](https://sourcey.com/docs/install.md): Every supported install path for Sourcey. npm, Homebrew, Docker, and Nix for the main CLI. Go, Homebrew, and Scoop for the standalone Go docs generator.
- [Quick Start](https://sourcey.com/docs/quickstart.md): From nothing to a running documentation site, with guides and an API reference, in a few minutes.
- [Project Structure](https://sourcey.com/docs/project-structure.md): Where Sourcey finds its config and content, and what a build writes.
- [Writing Pages](https://sourcey.com/docs/writing-pages.md): Markdown files with frontmatter, how a page is titled and summarised, and the Markdown every page can use.
- [Markdown components](https://sourcey.com/docs/components.md): Write guides with callouts, tabs, linked page lists, responsive media and build-time components that remain readable outside the browser.
- [Documentation versions](https://sourcey.com/docs/versions.md): Keep current and historical documentation together, with separate content roots, stable URLs and matching reference material.
- [Languages and translations](https://sourcey.com/docs/languages.md): Publish existing translations with matching navigation, language metadata and explicit fallback rules.
- [OpenAPI Integration](https://sourcey.com/docs/openapi-integration.md): An API reference from an OpenAPI or Swagger spec, with request examples, a request console and editorial overlays.
- [Try it](https://sourcey.com/docs/try-it.md): Send API requests from your documentation, with editable fields and live responses.
- [MCP Integration](https://sourcey.com/docs/mcp-integration.md): A reference for a Model Context Protocol server's tools, resources and prompts, from a snapshot of the server.
- [Rustdoc Adapter](https://sourcey.com/docs/rustdoc-integration.md): Generate Rust API documentation from nightly rustdoc JSON. Doctests as a first-class extracted view. Snapshot mode for CI on stable Rust.
- [Migrating to Sourcey](https://sourcey.com/docs/migrating.md): Move an existing documentation site to Sourcey once, keeping every page, route and anchor.
- [Migrating from Astro](https://sourcey.com/docs/migrating/astro.md): Convert Starlight or custom Astro documentation to native Sourcey, mounted inside the same Astro site.
- [Migrating from MkDocs](https://sourcey.com/docs/migrating/mkdocs.md): Convert mkdocs.yml and its Markdown to a native Sourcey project, keeping every URL and anchor.
- [Migrating from Docusaurus](https://sourcey.com/docs/migrating/docusaurus.md): Convert a Docusaurus site's docs, versions and translations to a native Sourcey project, keeping every URL and anchor.
- [Migrating from Mintlify](https://sourcey.com/docs/migrating/mintlify.md): Convert a Mintlify docs.json project to a native Sourcey project, keeping every page URL and most components as written.
- [Themes & Layout](https://sourcey.com/docs/themes-and-layout.md): Four themes, brand colours, fonts, layout widths, light and dark, custom CSS and icons.
- [Search](https://sourcey.com/docs/search.md): Full-text search built with the site, searched in the reader's browser with no service behind it.
- [Documentation for agents](https://sourcey.com/docs/context-exports.md): Publish readable Markdown, API contracts and discovery files from the same sources as your website.
- [Deploying](https://sourcey.com/docs/deploying.md): Publish the built folder on any static host, at its root or beneath a path, or inside an Astro site.

## Guides

- [Your First Docs Site](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/guide-first-docs-site.md): Build a documentation site from scratch, with Markdown guides and an API reference.
- [Custom Branding](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/guide-custom-branding.md): Your colours, fonts and logo on any theme.
- [Multi-Tab Sites](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/guide-multi-tab-sites.md): Guides, API references and code references side by side in one site.
- [Tutorial: Document Your MCP Server](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/guide-mcp-docs.md): Snapshot an MCP server, build its reference, and add guides beside it, in a few minutes.
- [Go / godoc Docs](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/guide-godoc-go.md): A Go module's reference from its package comments, exported symbols and examples.
- [Doxygen / C++ Docs](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/guide-doxygen-cpp.md): A C or C++ library's reference from Doxygen's XML.
- [Embedding in Existing Sites](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/guide-embedding.md): Serve the documentation beneath a path of an existing website, inside Astro or beside any other framework.
- [Build Ask AI with Sourcey and LangChain](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/guide-langchain-retriever.md): Implement your own Ask AI feature over a Sourcey docs site.
- [Generating an MCP snapshot](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/mcp-snapshot.md): Snapshot a running MCP server, or write the snapshot by hand.
- [MCP Ecosystem](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/mcp-ecosystem.md): mcp-schema and mcp-parser, TypeScript tooling for MCP server specifications.

## Configuration

- [Configuration](https://sourcey.com/docs/config/ref-config.md): Set up Sourcey with TypeScript config, page groups, and reference tabs.
- [Navigation](https://sourcey.com/docs/config/ref-navigation.md): Tabs, sidebar groups, nested sections, section pages, links and the order readers move through them.

## CLI

- [sourcey init](https://sourcey.com/docs/cli/cli-init.md): Start a Sourcey project, with the specs and Doxygen setup it finds beside it.
- [sourcey dev](https://sourcey.com/docs/cli/cli-dev.md): Preview the site while you write, with each change drawn as you save it.
- [sourcey build](https://sourcey.com/docs/cli/cli-build.md): Build the site as static files, or a single spec's reference without a config.
- [sourcey check](https://sourcey.com/docs/cli/cli-check.md): Check a site's sources, routes and links without writing it.
- [sourcey validate](https://sourcey.com/docs/cli/cli-validate.md): Read an OpenAPI spec and report its errors, without building anything.
- [sourcey migrate](https://sourcey.com/docs/cli/cli-migrate.md): Convert an Astro, MkDocs, Docusaurus or Mintlify project to native Sourcey, once.
- [sourcey godoc](https://sourcey.com/docs/cli/cli-godoc.md): Snapshot a Go module's documentation into a JSON file, so the site builds without Go.

## Changelog

- [Changelog](https://sourcey.com/docs/changelog.md): Sourcey release notes.
